{{Quote|That… thing. In the hallway, while we were trying to get off the ''Profundity''. It killed at least a dozen of my men, cut them down like they were nothing. Blasters had no effect, it just kept on coming, kept on killing. It was like… like a nightmare. I've never seen anything like it, like some kind of death angel.|Jefkin, to Antilles, on Darth Vader|<ref name="Raymus">{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>}}
'''Toshma Jefkin''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Rebel trooper|soldier]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance Military|military]] and as a [[Security guard|guard]] in the [[Alderaanian consular security]]. He was serving aboard the ''[[Tantive IV]]'' as its [[second officer]] in [[1 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Launch!|Toshma Jefkin orders the launch of the ''Tantive IV''|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Toshma Jefkin<ref name="RO junior">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> served in the [[Alderaanian consular security]], a [[Law enforcement agency|force]] responsible for guarding and escorting [[Alderaanian]] dignitaries.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> Because the [[House of Organa|royal family]] of [[Alderaan]] was secretly affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Jefkin himself was involved in the [[Galactic Civil War|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[Rebel trooper|soldier]] of the [[Alliance Military|Rebel Military]].<ref name="RO junior" /> By the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Jefkin served as [[second officer]] on the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', a [[CR90 corvette]] commanded by [[Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles]] and used by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] as her [[consular ship]]. By then, Jefkin and the captain had served together for years, sharing many close encounters with Imperial forces.<ref name="Raymus" />

[[File:Death_of_a_crewmate.png|thumb|left|250px|Jefkin watches in horror as the [[Unidentified fleet trooper|crewmate]] who gave him the datacard is killed by Darth Vader.]]
After it was damaged in a perilous mission, the ''Tantive IV'' was docked aboard the Rebel [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] flagship ''[[Profundity]]'', where it underwent repairs.<ref name="Rogue One novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref> However, the ''Profundity'' was sent to [[Scarif]], where a team of Rebels attempted to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. After the ''Profundity'' intercepted the rebel transmission of the Death Star plans, the redoubtable [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader]] boarded the [[cruiser]]. Having copied the stolen plans on a [[datacard]], some crewmembers of the ''Profundity'' attempted to board the ''Tantive IV'' in time. The bearer of the the datacard, however, could not enter the corvette because of a jammed security door. On the other side of the door, Jefkin managed to get ahold of the precious device through a slight opening. Once in possession of the plans, he charged through the corridors of the ''Profundity'' until he reached the cruiser's docking bay and the entry hatch to the ''Tantive IV''. The moment Jefkin boarded the corvette, he ordered the ship's launch.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Once the ''Tantive IV'' zoomed away, leaving the hangar behind, the security guard handed the datacard off to a woman who then took it to Captain Antilles.<ref name="RO junior" />

His encounter with Vader, whose identity was unknown to him, left Jefkin deeply rattled. He recountered the incident shortly afterward in a meeting with the ''Tantive IV{{'s}}'' senior [[officer]]s and Organa as they tried to decide how to proceed with delivering the Death Star plans.<ref name="Raymus" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Unlimited-PoweroftheDarkSide.png|thumb|right|300px|Darth Vader's assault on the rebel soldiers (pictured) was horrifying to Toshma Jefkin.]]
A [[Gender|male]] [[human]], Jefkin had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Equipment==
As a member of the Alderaanian consular security, Jefkin carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol]] and wore the traditional uniform, which featured a service [[Armor|helmet]] with flash visor and integral [[comlink]] and a multi-pocketed [[spacer]] vest of [[Corellian]] cut.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toshma Jefkin was portrayed by [[Christopher Patrick Nolan]] in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''..<ref name="Rogue One" /> Nolan was at [[Pinewood Studios]] for four days, during additional photography and reshoots, and his part was filmed in three days.<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsawakens.nl/interviews/exclusief-interview-christopher-patrick-nolan-rogue-one|text=Exclusief interview met Christopher Patrick Nolan (Rogue One)|work=[https://www.starwarsawakens.nl StarWarsAwaken.nl]|archivedate=20170303194006}}</ref>

The character's name was coined in [[Matt Forbeck]]'s [[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] of the movie.<ref name="RO junior" /> With the approval of [[Jennifer Heddle]] and the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]], Forbeck named the character in tribute to his friend [[Jeff Mackintosh]], who had died of brain cancer in the fall of 2016<ref name="Interview2">{{WebCite|url=http://www.forbeck.com/2017/03/28/rogue-one-junior-novel-hardcover-out-today|text=Rogue One junior novel hardcover out today|work=[http://www.forbeck.com Forbeck.com]|archivedate=20170329003550}}</ref> and was a ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|mforbeck|status/1056390642295816193|[[Matt Forbeck]]|quote=He loved Star Wars.|archivedate=https://archive.is/oJsI9}}</ref>
